name: Dark Thaumaturgical Rituals — 2 Intermediate — Plague's Secret Domain

system.description: An hour-long chant burning a dove's corpse, ending with the caster defeating the victim in a Mental Challenge after spending Willpower Traits, inflicts a crushing depression that imposes penalties on Social, Mental, and life-threatening challenges for a duration based on the Willpower spent, potentially driving the victim to torpor or suicide.
